timeline.rule: F_k = T0 + playMs + k*segmentMs (+wall step), cb_k = F_k + lag_k, birth_k = cb_k + 1, mtime_k = cb_{k+1}

cases.name: in-order: each line before its file (live sweep)
out-of-order: the line after the file defers N until the line's sweep
lost line: a later id proves N's line was never written (no deferral)
lost line at the head: deferred for at most deferMaxMs, then written with the fallback
final sweep with missing stamps never defers; legacy for those fragments only
crash-cut fragment: finalized:false, no END line, mtime - lag - startTs
clean final fragment: XG-FRAGMENT-END gives endTs - startTs
clock step +S between N=1 and N+1=2: exactly fragment 1 changes, by S
clock step -S between N=1 and N+1=2: exactly fragment 1 changes, by S
clock step -S larger than a segment (floored at 0) between N=1 and N+1=2: exactly fragment 1 changes, by S
out-of-guard lag: 7001 and -1 rejected (legacy), 7000 accepted
a startTs that is not a sane epoch is rejected (legacy)
fragment 0: exact startTs from its own stamp, no boundary walk-back
fragment 0 without its stamp keeps the legacy boundary walk-back
host SIGKILL between the callback and the file: line 2 without file 2
untimed run in exact mode: no line at all = the legacy plan byte for byte, never deferred
0-byte and raced fragments are skipped, never deferred; reaped on the final sweep
WP1 rig shape: fragment 0 lag 12 ms, N>=1 lag 2000 ms (all exact, nothing deferred)
WP1 rig shape, line 1 lost: legacy 1 is shifted by lag(0) = 12 ms only
clean final: endTs one frame AHEAD of the END callback wall and the mtime is not clamped
lost line N+1: exact N and the SHIFTED legacy N+1 are contiguous (no replay gap)
R-WP2-2 crash final sweep: newest fragment's own line pending, written legacy finalized:false
R-WP2-7 startTs off cbWallMs - lagMs by 2 ms is rejected, by 1 ms accepted
D56 several consecutive lost lines: legacy 2 and 3 shifted by the same lag(1)
D56 lost line then a recovered exact line: exact 1, shifted 2, exact 3, both seams contiguous
D56 a 10.5 s rotation stall does not fake a step: durationMs = legacy's
D56 a real 8500 ms wall step with line 2 lost is measured exactly as legacy measures it
D56 a real 30000 ms wall step with line 2 lost is measured exactly as legacy measures it
D56 a 0-byte successor with its line lost: no shift, fragment 0 unchanged (mtime - lag - start)
D56 a stat-less successor with its line lost: no shift, fragment 0 unchanged (mtime - lag - start)
D56 N+1 missing while N+2 exists: legacy 3 is shifted by lag(1) through the missing id 2
D56 a rejected line's lag is never used: legacy 1 and 2 shifted by lag(0) = 2100, not 7001
